name: What is included in a garage wall framing project estimate?

mainEntity.name: What is included in a garage wall framing project estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: A comprehensive estimate for garage wall framing typically includes the cost of materials (lumber or steel studs, sheathing, fasteners), labor for construction, equipment rental if needed, and potentially permit application fees. It should also detail the scope of work, project timeline, and payment schedule. Reputable contractors will provide a clear, itemized breakdown, allowing you to understand all costs involved. Be sure to ask about any potential additional costs or contingencies.
acceptedAnswer.description: An estimate includes material costs (studs, sheathing), labor, equipment rental, and permit fees, detailing the scope of work and timeline.
